items.text: Approving various routine parking and traffic modifications: (The proposed parking and traffic modifications have been reviewed pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act [CEQA]. The proposed action is the Approval Action for Items A-F as defined by S.F. Administrative Code Chapter 31. Explanatory documents include a staff report and resolution.) A. RESCIND – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING, 7 AM TO 9 AM, EXCEPT SATURDAY AND SUNDAY, Prague Street, east side, from Geneva Avenue to South Hill Boulevard. B. RESCIND – WHITE ZONE, PASSENGER LOADING, AT ALL TIMES, Jones Street, east side, from Golden Gate Avenue to 131 feet southerly. D. ESTABLISH – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING ANY TIME, Jones Street, east side, from Golden Gate Avenue to 175 feet southerly. E.
